payload.friendly_name: Align open-packs to charter main with pack-doctor
payload.purpose_context: The charter renamed its standalone checker to pack-doctor and now refuses inline anti-patterns, stale manifests and unresolved references on every surface. Open-packs' nightly run against charter main is red (#343). This mission moves the pin tooling, report parsing, pack content and fixtures to what charter main ships, so pack authors get one answer from the charter instead of a drifting Python copy.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make every open pack pass the charter's own pack checker at charter main, and retire the Python copies of its rules.

payload.question: Dedupe the 273 inline anti-pattern entries (270 distinct titles) only for same-practice duplicates within a pack or an existing depends_on (~265 files), or merge by meaning to ~150 with new cross-pack depends_on?

Severity rubric: per entry by the schema definitions (smell worth a remark, severe should block review, breaking must block) with a one-line grounding per call in a curation ledger, ungroundable entries batched to the operator?
For the 131 title/content entries, is bad_example the content's concrete-instance sentence verbatim (description = full content), with no-instance entries batched to the operator?

payload.wp_title: Curation tool, ledger contract, and the 15 file-less nodes
Ledger D, the internal styleguides and testing (49 entries)
The pack-doctor gate at a charter-main pin
Restamp with pack-doctor remediate, and the derived artifacts
Ledger B, foundation, qa, pack-authoring and planning-analysis (58 entries)
Retire the Python rules pack-doctor judges; keep the house rules
Ledger C, the internal procedures and feature-and-scenario-authoring (59 entries)
Ledger A, the language stacks (68 entries)

payload.final_answer: Merge by MEANING across packs, aiming for ~150 files. Each shared anti-pattern lives in ONE home pack: the most foundational pack upstream of the others, preferring one existing depends_on already reaches. Other packs reject it with a pack-qualified rejects edge (<pack>::anti_pattern:<id>). Add depends_on only where needed, never a cycle. Record every merge in the ledger (merged entries, pack of origin, chosen home, why). A merge whose meanings genuinely differ becomes an operator question. Batch the ledger WPs by HOME pack so the home file exists before any dependent pack's rejects edge. (operator ruling 2026-11-25, relayed by the dispatcher session_01E5wJU9WQgVdyyBRFbVHcGL)

approve rubric: decide each entry by the schema's definitions (smell is worth a remark, severe should block review, breaking must block), with a one-line grounding that quotes the entry or its host text, in the ledger. Batch no-signal entries to the dispatcher for the operator; never guess. (operator ruling 2026-11-25, relayed by the dispatcher session_01E5wJU9WQgVdyyBRFbVHcGL)

For the 131 title/content entries, the curator WRITES a short, concrete bad example grounded in the content. The content is the description. Each authored example is marked authored in the ledger (bad_example_source: authored, grounded in <content clause>). These are new doctrine, and WP review must read every one. (operator ruling 2026-11-25, relayed by the dispatcher session_01E5wJU9WQgVdyyBRFbVHcGL)
